reason: Equivalent on every reachable input, and measured (CONST, 0.0 -> 1.0). `_NO_WOOD_TANK_C` is the wood tank temperature `_thermostat_held_state` gives the reference on a two-tank house, standing for "no wood": the constant's own contract is "colder than any zone it could feed". The reference's wood side has two readers in the model: the valve's wood share, which takes nothing from a tank below the zone it feeds, and the hot-water refill coil, which the reference does not carry (owner ruling, 2026-11-04: no wood tank, no fire, no refill coil in the reference). Every zone the comfort bounds allow sits far above both 0.0 and 1.0 C, so either value takes no share, and a reference step books the plain valve's kW under both. Measured by a differential drive of `HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize` over 192 cases (weather winter_cold, winter_mild, shoulder, summer_cool; prices flat, winter_extreme, winter_typical; single and two zone; no valve and a manual valve; with and without the two-tank 4-way layout, 24 cases resolving `two_tank_modelled`; two start states with wood tanks at 60 and 80 C), the head against the module constant set to 1.0: 0 of 192 plans differ bitwise in predicted cost, predicted saving or baseline power schedule. Separately, the R10-HOTFIX-SAV-ESTIMATE pin drive (`mutation-autofix`, run 42024722714) named the site a survivor of every driver whose closure holds optimizer.py.
